newsitem.title: USA: Valuevest, Sturm take stake in Little Switzerland.
newsitem.headline: Valuevest, Sturm take stake in Little Switzerland.

text.p: ValueVest Partners LP and Donald Sturm said through attorneys on Tuesday that they reported to the Securities and Exchange Commission a 9.9 percent stake in Little Switzerland Inc with an eye toward acquiring the company.

According to the law firm of Rogers and Wells, an SEC Schedule 13D reporting that ValueVest, an investment fund managed by ValueVest Management Co. LLC, and Sturm, a private investor, on May 2 owned 837,400 of Little Switzerland's roughly 8,462,000 outstanding shares. Of those, 400,000 shares were acquired between January 8 and March 18 at prices ranging from $4.70 to $5 per share. The remaining 437,400 shares were purchased between April 25 and May 2 at prices ranging from $4.875 to $5.237 per share.

In describing the purpose of the acquisitions, the SEC filing said, "ValueVest and Sturm have determined to make a significant equity investment in the issuer with a view to possibly seeking to acquire the issuer. ValueVest and Sturm have informed the president of the issuer of their interest in acquiring the Issuer and have discussed that interest with one of the directors of the Issuer. A representative of ValueVest and Sturm also has had conversations with an investment banker who said he was speaking on behalf of the issuer about the possibility that ValueVest and Sturm might be interested in acquiring the iIssuer."
